query:
INSERT INTO
          withdrawals (
            tx_hash,
            l2_block_number,
            token,
            amount,
            event_index_in_tx,
            l1_receiver,
            withheld
          )
        SELECT
          u.tx_hash,
          u.l2_block_number,
          u.token,
          u.amount,
          u.index_in_tx,
          u.l1_receiver,
          $7 :: bool
        FROM
          unnest(
            $1 :: BYTEA [],
            $2 :: bigint [],
            $3 :: BYTEA [],
            $4 :: numeric [],
            $5 :: integer [],
            $6 :: BYTEA []
          ) AS u(
            tx_hash,
            l2_block_number,
            token,
            amount,
            index_in_tx,
            l1_receiver
          ) ON CONFLICT (
            tx_hash,
            event_index_in_tx
          ) DO NOTHING
